sayings.word: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
sayings.reflection: Tomorrow is not in your hands. This day is enough.
sayings.step: Name one thing that is actually yours to do before nightfall.

sayings.word: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
sayings.reflection: Emptiness is not a failure here.
sayings.step: Sit with being poor in spirit instead of covering it.

sayings.word: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
sayings.reflection: Tears are not a detour from Him.
sayings.step: Let one grief be named without fixing it.

sayings.word: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
sayings.reflection: Strength that does not grab is still strength.
sayings.step: Yield one argument you were rehearsing.

sayings.word: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.
sayings.reflection: The ache for what is right is itself a kind of prayer.
sayings.step: Do one just thing you have been postponing.

sayings.word: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
sayings.reflection: Mercy received becomes mercy given.
sayings.step: Offer one small mercy where you wanted a score.

sayings.word: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
sayings.reflection: A clear heart sees farther than a crowded one.
sayings.step: Put down one secret you have been polishing.

sayings.word: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
sayings.reflection: Peace is made, not announced.
sayings.step: Take one quiet step toward a rift.

sayings.word: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
sayings.reflection: Presence can season a room without a speech.
sayings.step: Be present in one place you usually disappear.

sayings.word: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden. Neither do you light a lamp, and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house. Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
sayings.reflection: Light is for houses, not hiding places.
sayings.step: Do one good work without announcing it.

sayings.word: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
sayings.reflection: Prayer for an enemy is not agreement. It is obedience.
sayings.step: Pray one honest sentence for someone who wounded you.

sayings.word: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret, and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
sayings.reflection: The closed door is enough of a chapel.
sayings.step: Pray once today where no one can see.

sayings.word: Pray like this: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us today our daily bread. Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’
sayings.reflection: He gave words when we had none.
sayings.step: Pray this slowly, once, without adding to it.

sayings.word: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal; but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal; for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
sayings.reflection: The heart follows what it stores.
sayings.step: Release one held thing that is owning you.

sayings.word: But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
sayings.reflection: First things stay first only if you put them first.
sayings.step: Give the first quiet minutes to His kingdom, not your list.

sayings.word: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you. For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
sayings.reflection: Asking is not a performance.
sayings.step: Ask for one thing you actually need.

sayings.word: Therefore whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
sayings.reflection: The measure you want is the measure you give.
sayings.step: Treat one person as you would hope to be treated.

sayings.word: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many are those who enter in by it. How narrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.
sayings.reflection: The wide road is crowded because it is easy.
sayings.step: Choose the harder honest path in one decision.

sayings.word: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
sayings.reflection: The invitation is to come, not to impress.
sayings.step: Lay down one burden you were never asked to carry.

sayings.word: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
sayings.reflection: Greatness here looks like a child's open hands.
sayings.step: Ask instead of assuming you already know.

sayings.word: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
sayings.reflection: He does not wait for a crowd.
sayings.step: Sit with one other person in His name.

sayings.word: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
sayings.reflection: Forgiveness is a practice, not a trophy.
sayings.step: Forgive one repeated offense without a speech.

sayings.word: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
sayings.reflection: What we clutch can close the way.
sayings.step: Loosen one grip on money or status.

sayings.word: Jesus said to him, “ ‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’ This is the first and great commandment. A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
sayings.reflection: Love of God and neighbor is one movement.
sayings.step: Love God by serving one neighbor in reach.

sayings.word: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’
sayings.reflection: The hidden ones are not hidden to Him.
sayings.step: Help one person who cannot repay you.

sayings.word: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth. Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
sayings.reflection: The last word is presence, not performance.
sayings.step: Speak one true word of His, then stay near.

sayings.word: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
sayings.reflection: The first call is still follow.
sayings.step: Leave one net that keeps you from walking after Him.

sayings.word: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven. “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake. Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
sayings.reflection: Faithfulness can cost, and He still calls it blessed.
sayings.step: Endure one slight without returning it.

sayings.word: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged. For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
sayings.reflection: The measure you use comes back to you.
sayings.step: Drop one verdict you have no right to settle.

sayings.word: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house on a rock. The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
sayings.reflection: Hearing without doing is sand.
sayings.step: Practice one word you already know.

sayings.word: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
sayings.reflection: He speaks before the wind dies.
sayings.step: Take heart in the storm you are actually in.

sayings.word: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
sayings.reflection: The field is not empty. The workers are few.
sayings.step: Pray for laborers, then be one in a small way.

sayings.word: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray? If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray. Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.
sayings.reflection: He leaves the ninety-nine. That is the news.
sayings.step: Go toward one person who drifted, without a lecture.

sayings.word: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
sayings.reflection: The kingdom is not too busy for the small.
sayings.step: Make room for a child, or the childlike, today.

sayings.word: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
sayings.reflection: Some things are Caesar's. Not everything is.
sayings.step: Give God what you have been giving to lesser lords.

sayings.word: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
sayings.reflection: Willingness is not the same as staying awake.
sayings.step: Watch with Him for a few undistracted minutes.

sayings.word: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
sayings.reflection: The ending of Matthew is companionship.
sayings.step: Walk into one hard place as if He is already there.

sayings.word: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
sayings.reflection: The lake can wait. The call cannot.
sayings.step: Follow in one concrete step, not a mood.

sayings.word: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
sayings.reflection: Rest was made for people, not people for a rule.
sayings.step: Keep one stretch of the day unproductive on purpose.

sayings.word: He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
sayings.reflection: He speaks to weather as if it can hear.
sayings.step: Ask for stillness in the one storm you cannot manage.

sayings.word: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”
sayings.reflection: Fear is loud. He still says only believe.
sayings.step: Believe one word of His against one fear.

sayings.word: For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
sayings.reflection: The whole world is a poor trade for a soul.
sayings.step: Refuse one gain that would cost who you are.

sayings.word: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples, and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
sayings.reflection: Following includes a cross, not a brand.
sayings.step: Deny one self-saving move.

sayings.word: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
sayings.reflection: Belief is not a trick. It is trust in Him.
sayings.step: Bring one impossible thing to Him without a script.

sayings.word: He sat down, and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”
sayings.reflection: The front of the line is the basin.
sayings.step: Take the last place in one room.

sayings.word: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
sayings.reflection: Do not become a wall between Him and the small.
sayings.step: Welcome one person the room overlooks.

sayings.word: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant. Whoever of you wants to become first among you, shall be bondservant of all. For the Son of Man also came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
sayings.reflection: He did not come to be served.
sayings.step: Serve one person who expects nothing.

sayings.word: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God. For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening; he shall have whatever he says. Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
sayings.reflection: Prayer is not a lever. It is trust spoken.
sayings.step: Pray one request and leave it with Him.

sayings.word: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment. The second is like this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”
sayings.reflection: All the law leans on these two loves.
sayings.step: Love God with one undivided hour; love a neighbor in it.

sayings.word: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch.”
sayings.reflection: The word is to all: watch.
sayings.step: Stay awake to one duty you have been sleeping through.

sayings.word: He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
sayings.reflection: The news is for every creature, not a club.
sayings.step: Tell one person what He actually said, not a slogan.

sayings.word: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed, and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”
sayings.reflection: The first sermon is good news to the poor.
sayings.step: Bring liberty, not advice, to one burdened person.

sayings.word: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you, bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
sayings.reflection: Blessing an enemy is a different kind of power.
sayings.step: Bless, do not curse, one person in your mouth today.

sayings.word: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”
sayings.reflection: Open hands are how the measure returns.
sayings.step: Give one thing generously and quietly.

sayings.word: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
sayings.reflection: Forgiveness and judgment cannot share a throne.
sayings.step: Release one person from a private court.

sayings.word: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
sayings.reflection: The simple rule is still the hard one.
sayings.step: Do for one person what you keep wishing someone would do for you.

sayings.word: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?” He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”
sayings.reflection: The neighbor is the one who showed mercy.
sayings.step: Go and do likewise in one ordinary street.

sayings.word: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things, but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
sayings.reflection: The better part is sitting, not proving.
sayings.step: Sit with His words before you serve them.

sayings.word: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
sayings.reflection: The Father knows how to give what is good.
sayings.step: Ask for the Holy Spirit more than for ease.

sayings.word: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these. But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?
sayings.reflection: The field is already dressed.
sayings.step: Look at one ordinary created thing and stop racing.

sayings.word: Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
sayings.reflection: Little flock is a tender name, not an insult.
sayings.step: Receive the kingdom as gift, not wage.

sayings.word: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
sayings.reflection: Follow the treasure and you will find the heart.
sayings.step: Move one treasure toward what lasts.

sayings.word: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.
sayings.reflection: Tragedy is not a ranking of sinners.
sayings.step: Repent of one real thing, not a vague mood.

sayings.word: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind; and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”
sayings.reflection: The guest list that cannot repay is the honest one.
sayings.step: Invite or help someone who cannot return the favor.

sayings.word: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross, and come after me, can’t be my disciple. For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
sayings.reflection: Discipleship has a price. He said so.
sayings.step: Count the cost of one obedience you already know.

sayings.word: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
sayings.reflection: Heaven notices one who turns.
sayings.step: Turn from one wandering without advertising it.

sayings.word: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
sayings.reflection: The small trust is the real one.
sayings.step: Be faithful in one unnoticed task.

sayings.word: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation; neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”
sayings.reflection: The kingdom is not a spectacle you can point at.
sayings.step: Look for His reign in the midst of this day.

sayings.word: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them? I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
sayings.reflection: He hears the ones who cry day and night.
sayings.step: Pray again for the justice you almost gave up on.

sayings.word: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’ I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”
sayings.reflection: The lowered eyes went home justified.
sayings.step: Pray for mercy instead of comparing yourself.

sayings.word: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
sayings.reflection: He is the seeker. You are not the hunt.
sayings.step: Let yourself be found in one hiding place.

sayings.word: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.
sayings.reflection: Forgiveness from the cross is the measure.
sayings.step: Forgive one person who does not know what they do.

sayings.word: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
sayings.reflection: Today is not too late for mercy.
sayings.step: Ask to be remembered, not ranked.

sayings.word: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
sayings.reflection: The first word of the risen one is peace.
sayings.step: Receive peace before you explain the day.

sayings.word: You are witnesses of these things.
sayings.reflection: A witness tells what happened, not a theory.
sayings.step: Tell one true thing you have actually seen Him do.

sayings.word: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
sayings.reflection: Seeing the kingdom begins with new birth, not new effort.
sayings.step: Admit one place you cannot remake yourself.

sayings.word: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
sayings.reflection: Love gave. That is the whole sentence.
sayings.step: Believe this gift instead of bargaining for it.

sayings.word: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again, but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
sayings.reflection: Some thirsts are not solved by another well.
sayings.step: Bring one thirst to Him instead of another cistern.

sayings.word: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers. God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
sayings.reflection: Worship is spirit and truth, not a ZIP code.
sayings.step: Worship once without an audience.

sayings.word: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
sayings.reflection: He offers Himself, not a technique.
sayings.step: Come to Him with hunger, not a performance.

sayings.word: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
sayings.reflection: Following Him is how darkness thins.
sayings.step: Walk one step in the light you already have.

sayings.word: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples. You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
sayings.reflection: Freedom is the fruit of abiding, not a slogan.
sayings.step: Continue in one word of His you already know.

sayings.word: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
sayings.reflection: He does not begin where we begin.
sayings.step: Let His I AM be larger than your timeline.

sayings.word: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.
sayings.reflection: The door has a name.
sayings.step: Enter by Him, not by a side bargain.

sayings.word: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
sayings.reflection: The good shepherd spends His life. He does not spend yours first.
sayings.step: Trust His care in one place you have been self-shepherding.

sayings.word: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies. Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
sayings.reflection: Resurrection is a person before it is an event.
sayings.step: Believe Him in one grief that feels final.

sayings.word: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
sayings.reflection: The way is not a map. It is Him.
sayings.step: Follow the Way in one confused decision.

sayings.word: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
sayings.reflection: His peace is not the world's version.
sayings.step: Let your heart unclench for one hour.

sayings.word: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me. I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
sayings.reflection: Fruit is the vine's work in the branch.
sayings.step: Abide: stay, do not strain for fruit.

sayings.word: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
sayings.reflection: The command is as simple as it is costly.
sayings.step: Love one person as you have been loved.

sayings.word: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
sayings.reflection: The greater love spends itself.
sayings.step: Lay down one convenience for a friend.

sayings.word: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
sayings.reflection: Trouble is told the truth: He has overcome.
sayings.step: Take heart in one tribulation without denying it.

sayings.word: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.” Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
sayings.reflection: His kingdom is not from here, and still He is King.
sayings.step: Listen to truth more than to the world's volume.

sayings.word: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
sayings.reflection: Love of Him becomes care for His.
sayings.step: Feed one of His sheep in a practical way.

sayings.word: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
sayings.reflection: The last word to Peter is still follow.
sayings.step: Stop comparing your road. Follow.

sayings.word: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
sayings.reflection: The new command has an old source: as I have loved you.
sayings.step: Love one person with the patience you have received.

sayings.word: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
sayings.reflection: A troubled heart is spoken to, not scolded.
sayings.step: Believe in Him with the trouble still in the room.

sayings.word: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
sayings.reflection: The vine is true. The dressing is the Father's.
sayings.step: Accept one pruning without calling it rejection.

sayings.word: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
sayings.reflection: The weary are the invited.
sayings.step: Come as you are tired, not as you are impressive.

sayings.word: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
sayings.reflection: He leaves peace the way a friend leaves a key.
sayings.step: Refuse the world's panic for one decision.
